thread:
tara: Quick sync: after bringing up q2b-int8 we noticed a shift in which prompts are flagged as duplicates by the sampler. seemed like entropy-based anchors are underrepresented in the golden.
jim: do you mean the dedupe LSH buckets changed, or the fingerprinting itself?
tara: more the fingerprinting; embedding sim thresholds unchanged but the top-k neighbors differ for ~4% of the samplebank (mostly long multi-sentence prompts).
anika: could be tokenizer differences affecting embedding model input. q2b-int8 uses a slightly different token padding/normalize step we added.
ravi: can you share a minimal sample list? good to show labelers what to expect.
tara: dropped a small holder: gs://redwood-sandbox/curation/entropy_drift/suspect_examples_2026-03-22.jsonl and a short diff of fingerprints: https://short.link/curation-diffs-322 (internal)
labeler-bot: new-sample: 120 items added to "suspect-entropy" queue. ETA label completion 72h.
jim: ok next steps I propose: 1) run tokenizer-fingerprint parity check between float and q2b-int8 pipelines 2) temporarily widen dedupe recall in sampler for long prompts while we build new golden anchors 3) add manual review batch to confirm true duplicates vs semantic drift
tara: agree. also want a small golden augmentation: +800 anchors sampled from the 99th entropy percentile, prioritized by length >512 tokens. we should keep them separate as longprompt-golden-2026Q1.
anika: I can add a normalization step that collapses repeated whitespace and normalizes unicode before embedding -> should reduce spurious diffs. will open PR.
ravi: labeling note: add instruction to the labeler rubric: "if two prompts share core semantic intent but differ by formatting/noise, mark as duplicate only if redundancy affects downstream scoring". will send updated rubric snippet.
jim: sampler tweak (temporary) command I used:
```bash
python -m curations.sampler \
  --src gs://redwood-sandbox/curation/samplebank.parquet \
  --min_len 512 \
  --entropy_pct 99 \
  --dedupe-sim-threshold 0.78 \
  --out ./work/long_entropy_candidates.jsonl
```
tara: we should also compute pairwise embedding deltas for flagged pairs to give labelers context. a small notebook helps.
anika: prepping notebook now, will include plots of cos-sim distributions and token-length vs sim.
labeler-bot: manual-review: long_entropy batch 120 assigned to cohort 'qa-curation'.
jim: can we add an automated check when onboarding a quantized model: tokenization parity + embedding fingerprint parity. it should be part of the bringup checklist.
tara: yes, create checklist item under ML onboarding doc. I'll add recommended thresholds (token parity >= 99.8%, embedding top-10 overlap >= 96%).
ravi: timeline: labeler rubric update + manual batch by Thurs, normalization PR by EOD Wed, sampler widen and sampling run Thurs morning, golden augment by Fri.
anika: infra note: if the embed-harness runs many samples we'll need a larger machine for the all-pairs. infra-bot: scheduled a 16-core runner for curations: r-run-2026-03-23, TTL 4h.
infra-bot: runner r-run-2026-03-23 status: provisioned.
tara: perfect. once label reviews land I'll merge top 800 anchors into longprompt-golden and tag for eval.
jim: eval plan: run q2b-int8 vs float32 vs q4b baseline on the new golden and report recall/precision per anchor, and a confusion matrix for duplicate detection. small script to compute recall:
```py
# simplified
for anchor in golden:
  preds = model.search_similar(anchor, k=50)
  recall = hit_in(preds, ground_truth_set)
  log(anchor.id, recall)
```
ravi: also collect labeler agreement for the manual batch (krippendorff or fleiss). we want to know if human labels are noisy.
anika: I'll include agreement metrics in the notebook.
tara: thanks team. I'll open ML ticket and assign owners (ML-3491). please tag any regressions you see elsewhere (summarization, translation) in case tokenizer normalization has side-effects.
labeler-bot: ML-3491 created; long_entropy review queue linked.
jim: cheers. let's reconvene after the first manual batch completes.
tara: thanks :wave:
